title: Issue 2817: execute binding assignments through configured transport

canonical_core.requested_outcome: A binding non-local Planning assignment with an authorized automatic transport compiles to and executes one revision-bound typed dispatch action in the ordinary path, while manual handoff remains an explicit fallback and returned work retains the existing admission, integration, proof, and reconciliation boundary.
canonical_core.hard_constraints: Do not add a scheduler, worker registry, orchestration database, second assignment authority, provider-specific fields to portable assignment semantics, silent local fallback, or completion authority for worker output.
canonical_core.agent_may_decide: Choose the smallest compatible operation and adapter split, exact fixture organization, and PR boundaries while preserving current assignment identity and lifecycle owners.
canonical_core.escalate_when: The fix requires a second assignment record, weakens proof/admission, changes target ranking, expands into #2818 context-cost work, or cannot preserve manual and unavailable transport behavior.
canonical_core.next_action: Merge PRs #2841, #2842, and #2846 in order, then apply the checked-in archive-owner integration proposal on the target branch; no implementation or feature-branch proof work remains.
proof_expectations: Deterministic retained-local, automatic CLI/internal, manual-only, unavailable/failure, and explicit override fixtures use the same canonical assignment semantics.
Automatic dispatch executes without delegation wording and returned work remains untrusted until existing admission and integration operations succeed.
Generated Python/TypeScript operation surfaces and installed package payloads remain conformant.
completion_criteria: A ready binding non-local assignment with an authorized automatic transport exposes and executes the dispatch operation itself as the primary ordinary action.
Manual-only and unavailable automatic transports never silently fall back to local implementation.
Dispatch is revision-bound and preserves scope, effects, stop conditions, proof obligation, return contract, and adapter identity without creating peer authority.
A substantive no-delegation-wording supported-host trace exercises automatic dispatch and the existing return lifecycle.
Focused, generated-conformance, package, and routed AW proof are green for every changed path.
canonical_core.closeout_decision: The feature stack satisfies #2817; close the issue only after PRs #2841, #2842, and #2846 merge in order and the archive-owner proposal is applied against current target-branch truth.
